content: Intl.DateTimeFormat dateStyle option: 'full'|'long'|'medium'|'short' shortcut; dateStyle:'short' in en-US yields e.g. 7/7/20 (2-digit year, numeric month/day, locale-dependent). Baseline Widely available since 2017. ArticleView already uses dateStyle:'medium' with navigator.language (ArticleView.tsx L108) — the short-date discretion mirrors this exact call with dateStyle:'short'.
